create_UFOGenScheduler: create a UFOGenScheduler instance with configurable beta schedule and diffusion timesteps for one-step image generation
run_UFOGenScheduler_step: run the UFOGenScheduler step function to denoise a sample from one diffusion timestep to the previous
build_betas_for_alpha_bar: build a beta noise schedule tensor from a cosine or exponential alpha_bar function over diffusion timesteps
test_rescale_zero_terminal_snr: test the rescale_zero_terminal_snr function to adjust betas for zero terminal signal-to-noise ratio
review_UFOGenScheduler_add_noise: review the UFOGenScheduler add_noise method that adds Gaussian noise to original samples at given timesteps
